name: Laptop goes to sleep
note: A laptop enrolled as a host closes its lid while a cloud agent messages it.

steps.label: heartbeats stop (lid closed)
steps.say: No goodbye; the link just goes quiet.

steps.label: host away after 90 s
steps.say: Laptop agents show as paused. They are pinned, so nothing is rescheduled.

steps.label: k2 msg laptop-agent
steps.say: A cloud agent sends work to the laptop agent.

steps.label: Queued{msg_id}
steps.say: The sender is told the truth: queued, not delivered.

steps.label: reconnect (new IP, same key)
steps.say: The lid opens on a different network. Identity is the key.

steps.label: drain outbox
steps.say: The message is delivered with its original id.

steps.label: Delivered{msg_id}
steps.say: The cloud agent's message reaches its final state (I2).
